subject: general
question: Which of the following does **not** come under the Ministry of Defence?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Department Of Border Management.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Departments under the Defence Ministry:

 
 
• ​Department of Defence (DOD)
 
• **Department of Defence Production (DDP)**
 
• **Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare (DESW)**
 
• **Defense Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**
 
• Department of Military Affairs (DMA)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• **Department of Border Management:**

 
 
• In pursuance of Group of Minister's recommendations on

 Border Management, the Department of Border Management was **created in the Ministry of Home Affairs** in **January 2004 **to pay focused attention to the issues relating to the management of international land and coastal borders, strengthening of border policing & guarding, creation of infrastructure like roads, fencing & flood lighting on the borders and implementation of Border Area Development Programme. 
 
 
 
• 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 
• Departments under Finance Ministry:
 
 
• Expenditure
 
• Revenue
 
• Financial Services
 
• Department of Investment and Public Asset Management
 
• Economic Affairs
 
 
 
• Departments under the Ministry of Home Affairs:
 
 
• **​Department Of Border Management**
 
• Department Of Internal Security
 
• Department Of Jammu, Kashmir And Ladakh Affairs
 
• Department Of Home
 
• Department Of Official Language
 
• Department Of States
